label: Hoodoo Run
note: Issue #610: the first race course, a loop through the desert round five rock towers, its start/finish line a short drive from Dorrin's yard (the mechanic_yard landmark in content/core/worlds/port_desert.json). Read by src/systems/racing/race_course.gd (RaceCourse). Everything is plateau x,z (the world's landmark coordinates; on the ball they are mapped onto the sphere like any landmark). `gates`: gate 0 is the start/finish line, the rest the checkpoints in the order you go through them; each faces along the racing line. `gate_width` is the gap between its two antennas (m). `line`: the racing line, in order, a loop (NPC racers follow it, issue #609). `grid`: the slots behind the start line (rows of two, `back_m` behind it, `row_m` between rows, `side_m` either side of the middle). `laps`: a race's laps. `draw_m`: gates and markers are built when you come this close to the course's middle and dropped past draw_m + 200. `clear_m`: the desert's boulders keep this far off the racing line and the gates (DesertLandforms clear circles). The rock towers it weaves round are hoodoos in content/look/desert_landforms.json.
